identity.title: Vorticity normalization: omega_ab omega^ab = 2 omega_a omega^a and the W^2 convention

theorem.setup: A is the general spatial antisymmetric 3x3 vorticity tensor with independent entries a=A_12, b=A_13, c=A_23 in an orthonormal frame; the dual vector is w_i = (1/2) eps_ijk A_jk.
claims: dual vector w = (c, -b, a), so w_i w_i = a^2 + b^2 + c^2
therefore A_ij A_ij = 2 w_i w_i (exact identity, any a,b,c)
W^2_registered := A_ij A_ij/(6 H^2) = w_i w_i/(3 H^2)
the v5/v10 display w_i w_i/H^2 = 3 * W^2_registered
with Theta = 3H, sqrt(A_ij A_ij)/Theta <= B implies W^2_registered <= (3/2) B^2

notes: Lean and Rocq are kernel-independent proof-assistant lineages; they machine-check the algebraic core 2*(a^2+b^2+c^2) equals the antisymmetric contraction after the dual-vector substitution, and the factor-3 / three-halves consequences. No majority vote; all five required axes must PASS under this contract hash.
